name: Bo Hines
summary:
Robert Nicholas "Bo" Hines (born August 29, 1995) is an American businessman, former government official, and former college football player from North Carolina. Since September 2025, he is CEO for Tether U.S., the United States arm of cryptocurrency stablecoin Tether Limited.
Hines played college football for the NC State Wolfpack and Yale Bulldogs.
